text: At a briefing Tuesday afternoon at the Marin Civic Annex, Dr. Elia Voss said the Ostrava Lake sediment study came from the Sarnow Institute, not from any local agency. Voss, who said she reviewed the report herself, pointed to a stamped cover sheet and a project code ending in “SL-14.” She told reporters the institute had sent a two-page summary on March 18 and that the core samples were taken from the lake’s north shelf in late February. “The authors are all listed under Sarnow,” she said, holding up a copy. A county clerk standing nearby confirmed the packet arrived by courier and was logged at 9:12 a.m. the same day.
